== Course of events ==

The coronation took place as a public ceremony in which the eldest son of the Queen of Ev was crowned King Evardo Fifteenth of Ev, formally raising Evardo to the throne before the people of the kingdom. The King and the Queen of Ev were both present, their roles marking the transfer of royal authority to Evardo as the new sovereign.

The ceremony came at a point in the broader course of events when Ozma's party was making its way back toward the Emerald City, and it preceded the joyful reunion of the Tin Woodman with the Scarecrow and Tiktok, after which the group returned together to the royal palace of Ev where Evardo now reigned as king.
